messages:
Alex (CEO): Quick Friday readout — pulling together a short set of tactical asks for the next 72h. Please read and reply with owners + blockers by EOD Mon. High level: 1) Private GA readiness: complete VPC/KMS onboarding doc + infra checklist. Target: Monday EOD for docs, canary Monday 08:00 UTC. 2) SLA & SLO: finalize public SLA with p99 latency targets for Dedicated (4k context) and failure lessons in playbook. 3) Cost: hit -12% per-token unit improvement via Redwood Optimize suggestions (batching/quantization). Infra to propose autoscale plan. 4) Quality: embedding regression flagged on three eval sets; Research to triage. 5) Ops: reduce stream error rate back under 0.5% (Wed spike ~2%). I'll host a quick sync Mon 10:00 UTC with leads. TL;DR — docs, SLA, cost plan, triage, canary. Thanks.

Maya (VP Product): Owning doc + rollout notes. I'll post links to the onboarding doc + checklist by Mon 16:00. Will need legal signoff for KMS wording — looping in Liam.

Carlos (VP Eng): Infra: autoscale + batching plan in progress. PR #482 is blocked on test infra flakiness. Priya can you help unblock? Also we need a short canary config, cc @deploy-bot.

Priya (Head of Infra): I'll take PR unblock. Capacity estimate: we can support EU canary at 50% of target QPS. Autoscale proposal link: https://go/reports/autoscale-proposal (draft). Will collapse into a 1-pager by Mon 09:00.

Liam (Head of Security): KMS wording — need to add HSM option + audit retention notes. Legal + Compliance must review; Sasha, can you coordinate review schedule? Also need to run a quick KMS threat model before GA.

Sasha (Product Ops): Coordinating reviews. I'll create a checklist in the product drive and ping legal. Also uploading the SLA draft here: https://go/docs/sla-draft — please leave comments inline.

Nina (CTO): On Wed incident — streams error rate spike to ~2% persisted ~36m, root cause was a memory leak in the adapter layer. Patch landed, mitigations deployed. Postmortem in incidents channel soon. We should add a regression test to prevent reintroduction.

deploy-bot: Scheduled EU canary rollout: Mon 08:00 UTC -> 3 nodes; rollback condition: p95 latency > 400ms OR error rate >1% over 5m. Deploy link: https://go/deploys/3355

Carlos (VP Eng): Noted. I'll update PR and link the canary config to the autoscale doc.

Alex (CEO): Appreciate it. Two asks: 1) Single-line status update by 09:00 Mon in this thread (docs, SLA, infra, research). 2) Leads call Mon 10:00 UTC — calendar invite soon. If any blocker that's a showstopper, ping me directly. :thumbsup: 

Maya (VP Product): Will do. :thumbsup: 

Sasha (Product Ops): Putting up a 1-hour slot for sync notes + watchlist.

Priya (Head of Infra): Done — I'll be on the 10:00 call. :white_check_mark: 

Liam (Head of Security): I'll aim for legal signoff timeline by Tue EOD.

Nina (CTO): Postmortem draft in incidents channel in 30m.

Alex (CEO): Thanks all. Short and sharp over the weekend. —Alex
